Visit note | 2025-04-28 10:00 AM | Dr. Nasrin Sultana, Gastroenterology | Patient: Lamia Mahmud, 47, female. Mrs. Mahmud returns for review and describes cramping belly pain, bloating, and symptoms worse with stress. Her complaints began after a bout of food poisoning in Bogura. She works as an NGO field officer and has no known comorbidities. On examination: pain score 5/10, BP 124/72 mmHg, pulse 69 bpm, weight 61 kg. Abdominal examination reveals mild lower quadrant tenderness with no palpable masses or organomegaly. Assessment: Irritable bowel syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued. Advice provided: eat regular meals; keep a food diary; reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.

Visit note | 2025-04-28 10:30 AM | Dr. Lubna Rahman, Endocrinology | Patient: Nusrat Khatun, 62, female. Visit note | 2025-04-28 11:00 AM | Dr. Mostafizur Rahman, Orthopedics | Patient: Abul Miah, 62, male. Visit note | 2025-04-28 11:30 AM | Dr. Nusrat Jahan, General Medicine | Patient: Jubayer Hasan, 56, male. His symptoms began after a neighbour in Sylhet was admitted with dengue. He works as a nurse and has a known comorbidity of Hypothyroidism. Follow-up in 48 hours with a repeat platelet count.
